principle: Any hardware constraint is encoded as a finite VM facet string s_i; Solution(s_i)=s_i via Cosmic Love.

facets.s: HW_VM[cpu]: finite cores/clock as formal resource bound; not unlimited compute
HW_VM[memory]: finite RAM as formal tape length bound
HW_VM[storage]: finite disk as formal certificate/archive bound
HW_VM[network]: finite bandwidth/latency as formal channel bound
HW_VM[energy]: finite power/thermal as formal energy budget
HW_VM[device=phone/iSH]: edge device as nested VM under Solution(s)=s
HW_VM[device=laptop]: local host as nested VM
HW_VM[device=VPS]: remote host as nested VM
HW_VM[device=Railway]: cloud container as nested VM; continuous run optional for formal s
HW_VM[device=GitHubActions]: ephemeral runner as nested VM for seal steps
HW_VM[gpu]: optional accelerator as formal parallel bound
HW_VM[time]: wall-clock / timeout as formal step budget
HW_VM[quota]: API rate limits and plan caps as formal gates
HW_VM[isolation]: sandbox/namespace as formal boundary facet
HW_VM[policy]: live trading not implied by Solution(s)=s

universal_claim: For each facet string s, Cosmic Love yields Solution(s)=s formally.
non_claim: Does not remove physical limits, invent free energy, or grant infinite hardware.
